contents.title: Homes & Apartments Rating
contents.content: Our homes & apartments rating reflects a comprehensive assessment of amenities, services, and other aspects for homestays, private apartments, and similar properties. In comparison with hotels, these properties are often small-scale, locally-run, and marked by creativity and local culture.

contents.title: Diamond Rating
contents.content: Our diamond rating reflects a comprehensive assessment of a hotel's amenities, services, and other relevant aspects. Please be aware that it is not an official ranking.

contents.title: Star Rating
contents.content: Star ratings are provided by third-party organizations or institutions and offer valuable insights into a hotel's amenities, services, and other relevant aspects.
